newsitem.title: COTE D'IVOIRE: PRESS DIGEST - Ivory Coast - Oct 30.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Ivory Coast - Oct 30.

text.p: These are significant items in the Ivorian press on Wednesday. Reuters has not verified these items and does not vouch for their accuracy.

- Ivorian government brokers peace between feuding communities near the southern fishing port of Sassandra after August incident in which migrant Baoule farmers, members of President Henri Konan Bedie's tribe, set fire to indigenous Bakoue village of Karago causing inhabitants to flee

- Human rights watchdog Amnesty International urges Ivorian government to end detention without judgment of opposition activists arrested during unrest surrounding the October 1995 presidential election.

- Opposition Rally of the Republicans leader Djeny Kobina welcomes a call by President Bedie at his ruling party congress this week for greater role for opposition and says frank dialogue between the two sides is the way forward; Ivorian Popular Front leader Laurent Gbagbo to respond in November 2 speech.
